input: Enroll in an online astronomy course for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a Beginner Online Astronomy Course
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll in a suitable online astronomy course designed for beginners.

questions.title: What is your main reason for studying astronomy?
questions.description: Understanding the motivation helps identify the right course focus, whether casual curiosity, a career pivot, or a specific topic like planets or cosmology.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for this course?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants a free course, a paid certificate program, or has a specific spending cap narrows down the options significantly.

questions.title: Which platforms have you already considered or used?
questions.description: The user may already have accounts on Coursera, edX, Udemy, or others, which would make enrollment faster and easier.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Time availability determines whether a self-paced course or a structured weekly-schedule course is more appropriate.

questions.title: Do you want an official certificate upon completion?
questions.description: Some users need a verifiable credential for academic or professional purposes, while others just want the knowledge.

questions.title: When do you want to start the course?
questions.description: Some courses have fixed start dates while others are always available; knowing the target start date helps filter options.

questions.title: Is there a specific astronomy topic you are most drawn to?
questions.description: Beginner courses vary in focus, covering areas such as the solar system, deep space, astrophysics basics, or observational stargazing skills.
